Leonardo DiCaprio as a US marshal investigating a missing patient at a hospital for the criminally insane on an island in 1954, with Mark Ruffalo; the twist about who he really is. Scorsese.
Andy is leaving for college and Woody, Buzz and the toys end up donated to Sunnyside daycare run by a pink strawberry-smelling bear, Lotso; the incinerator scene. Not the first one.
Colin Firth as King George VI with a stammer, treated by an unconventional Australian speech therapist (Geoffrey Rush) before the wartime radio speech.
Natalie Portman as a ballerina cast as both the white and the black swan in Swan Lake, losing her mind under the pressure and the rival dancer Mila Kunis. Darren Aronofsky.
DreamWorks: Hiccup, a weak Viking boy, befriends an injured Night Fury dragon he names Toothless and builds it a tail fin. The first one.
1960s Mississippi: a young white writer, Skeeter (Emma Stone), interviews Black maids like Aibileen and Minny (Viola Davis, Octavia Spencer) for a book; the chocolate pie.

target: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 2
query: The final Harry Potter: the Battle of Hogwarts, breaking out of Gringotts on a dragon, Snape's memories in the Pensieve and Harry facing Voldemort. The last part, not Philosopher's Stone.
Ryan Gosling as a quiet Hollywood stunt driver who moonlights as a getaway driver, wears a scorpion jacket and falls for his neighbour Carey Mulligan; the elevator scene and synth music.

Batman comes out of retirement after eight years to face Bane, who breaks his back and throws him in a pit prison while taking over Gotham with a nuclear bomb; Anne Hathaway as Catwoman. The third Nolan one.
Jamie Foxx as a freed slave who becomes a bounty hunter with a German dentist (Christoph Waltz) to rescue his wife from Leonardo DiCaprio's plantation, Candyland. Tarantino.
Jennifer Lawrence as Katniss Everdeen, who volunteers in place of her sister for a televised fight to the death between teenagers from twelve districts; the mockingjay pin. The first one.
Ben Affleck as a CIA agent who gets six American diplomats out of Tehran in 1979 by pretending they are a Canadian crew scouting a fake sci-fi film. True story.
Daniel Craig's Bond: a former MI6 agent played by Javier Bardem hunts M, and it ends at the old family estate in Scotland with the Aston Martin; Adele song. Not Spectre.
Sandra Bullock and maybe Matt Damon as astronauts left drifting in orbit after debris destroys their shuttle; she has to reach the Chinese space station alone. Alfonso Cuarón.
Leonardo DiCaprio as Jordan Belfort, a stockbroker who gets rich through fraud, drugs and wild parties; Jonah Hill as his partner and the quaalude crawl. Scorsese.

Disney: Princess Anna goes after her sister Elsa, whose ice powers trapped their kingdom in eternal winter, with the iceman Kristoff, his reindeer Sven and the snowman Olaf; 'Let It Go'. The first one.
Chiwetel Ejiofor as Solomon Northup, a free Black man from New York kidnapped and sold into slavery in Louisiana; Michael Fassbender as a cruel plantation owner. Steve McQueen.
Joaquin Phoenix as a lonely letter writer in near-future LA who falls in love with his computer's AI operating system, voiced by Scarlett Johansson. Spike Jonze.
Ben Affleck's wife Amy (Rosamund Pike) disappears on their anniversary and he becomes the suspect, but she has faked it to frame him. David Fincher.
Miles Teller as a young jazz drummer at a music conservatory, terrorised by the abusive bandleader Terence Fletcher (J. K. Simmons): 'not quite my tempo'.
Wes Anderson: the concierge Monsieur Gustave (Ralph Fiennes) and his lobby boy Zero get caught up in the theft of the painting 'Boy with Apple', in a pink hotel in a made-up European country.
Marvel: Star-Lord (Chris Pratt), a raccoon with guns, a tree that only says 'I am Groot', Gamora and Drax team up to protect an orb; a Walkman mixtape of 70s songs.
Benedict Cumberbatch as Alan Turing, who builds a machine to break the German Enigma code at Bletchley Park in WWII and is later prosecuted for being gay.
Tom Hardy as Max and Charlize Theron as Furiosa escape the warlord Immortan Joe across the desert in a war rig with his wives; the flame-throwing guitarist.
Matt Damon as an astronaut stranded on Mars after his crew think he is dead; he grows potatoes and has to science his way to survival until a rescue. Ridley Scott.
Pixar: the emotions Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust inside 11-year-old Riley's head after her family moves to San Francisco; Bing Bong the imaginary friend. The first one, not the sequel.
Leonardo DiCaprio as frontiersman Hugh Glass, mauled by a bear and left for dead by Tom Hardy's character in the 1820s, crawls back for revenge for his son; the role that finally won him the Oscar.
Boston Globe reporters (Michael Keaton, Mark Ruffalo, Rachel McAdams) investigate how the Catholic Church covered up child abuse by priests; won best picture.
Amy Adams as a linguist trying to talk to seven-limbed aliens who write in circular ink symbols after twelve shells land around the world; the twist about her daughter. Denis Villeneuve.
Disney: Judy Hopps becomes the first bunny police officer in a city of animals and teams up with the con artist fox Nick Wilde to find missing predators; the sloth at the DMV.
Andrew Garfield as Desmond Doss, a conscientious objector who refuses to carry a rifle and saves 75 men as an army medic at Okinawa. Mel Gibson directed.
Three chapters in the life of Chiron, a Black boy growing up in Miami, with a drug dealer father figure played by Mahershala Ali; won best picture after the envelope mix-up.
Christopher Nolan's WWII film about the evacuation of British soldiers from the beaches of Dunkirk, told on land, sea and air on three time scales; Harry Styles, and Tom Hardy as a Spitfire pilot.
Pixar: Miguel, a Mexican boy who wants to be a musician despite his family's ban, ends up in the Land of the Dead on Día de los Muertos and meets his ancestors; 'Remember Me'.
Frances McDormand as a mother who rents three billboards to call out the police chief (Woody Harrelson) for not solving her daughter's murder; Sam Rockwell as the racist cop.
A family survives in silence on a farm because blind monsters hunt by sound; Emily Blunt gives birth in a bathtub, and John Krasinski directed and plays the father. The first one.
Thanos (Josh Brolin) collects all six Infinity Stones and snaps his fingers to wipe out half of all life, after a big battle in Wakanda. Not Endgame, the one before it.
Rami Malek as Freddie Mercury in the Queen biopic, from forming the band to the Live Aid concert at Wembley.
Chadwick Boseman as T'Challa, king of the hidden African nation Wakanda, challenged by his cousin Killmonger (Michael B. Jordan); vibranium and the Dora Milaje. Marvel.

Animated: Brooklyn teen Miles Morales becomes Spider-Man and meets spider-people from other dimensions, an older Peter B. Parker, Spider-Gwen and Spider-Ham, against Kingpin's collider. The first one.
Viggo Mortensen as an Italian-American bouncer who drives the Black pianist Dr. Don Shirley (Mahershala Ali) on a concert tour of the Deep South in the 1960s; the fried chicken scene.
Rian Johnson whodunit: a rich crime novelist dies after his 85th birthday party, Daniel Craig is detective Benoit Blanc, and the nurse Marta throws up whenever she lies. Not Glass Onion.
Sam Mendes WWI film: two young British soldiers must cross no man's land to deliver a message calling off an attack that would kill 1,600 men, made to look like one continuous shot.

Christopher Nolan: John David Washington as the Protagonist, who learns to move through time inversion to stop a Russian oligarch from ending the world; a plane crashed into a hangar and a reverse car chase.
Pixar: Joe Gardner, a middle school music teacher who dreams of jazz, falls into a manhole just before his big gig, and his soul ends up mentoring 22, a soul who doesn't want to be born.
Frances McDormand as a widow who loses everything in the recession and lives in her van, travelling the American West and working seasonal jobs at an Amazon warehouse. Chloé Zhao.
Timothée Chalamet as Paul Atreides on the desert planet Arrakis with giant sandworms and the spice, betrayed by the Harkonnens. Denis Villeneuve's part one, not the 1984 version.
Tom Holland's Peter Parker asks Doctor Strange to make the world forget he is Spider-Man; the spell goes wrong, villains from other universes arrive and the older Spider-Men come back.
Ruby, the only hearing member of a deaf fishing family in Massachusetts, wants to sing and audition for Berklee instead of working on the boat; remake of a French film, won best picture.
Michelle Yeoh as a Chinese-American laundromat owner being audited by the IRS who jumps between universes, including one where people have hot dog fingers, to fight an evil version of her daughter.
Jake Sully and Neytiri's family flee to the reef people of Pandora and learn to ride sea creatures while Colonel Quaritch returns as an avatar; the outcast tulkun Payakan. The sequel.
Robert Pattinson as a young brooding Batman investigating a serial killer, the Riddler, who leaves puzzles for him in Gotham; Zoë Kravitz as Catwoman. Not the Christian Bale ones.

On an Irish island in 1923, Colin Farrell's simple farmer is devastated when his best friend (Brendan Gleeson) suddenly stops speaking to him and threatens to cut off his own fingers; the donkey Jenny.
Margot Robbie as Barbie, who leaves pink Barbieland for the real world with Ken (Ryan Gosling), who discovers patriarchy; Greta Gerwig, 'I'm Just Ken'.
Scorsese: the Osage murders in 1920s Oklahoma; Leonardo DiCaprio marries an Osage woman, Mollie, for her oil money while his uncle Robert De Niro plots to kill her family.
Animated sequel: Miles Morales follows Gwen into the Spider-Society led by Miguel O'Hara, the villain is The Spot, and it ends on a cliffhanger. Not the first one.
Emma Stone as Bella Baxter, a woman revived by a scientist (Willem Dafoe) with the brain of her unborn baby, who runs off on an adventure across Europe with a lawyer (Mark Ruffalo). Yorgos Lanthimos.
A grumpy classics teacher (Paul Giamatti) at a New England boarding school has to look after the students who can't go home over Christmas in 1970, with a grieving cook. Alexander Payne.
Paul Atreides joins the Fremen with Chani (Zendaya), rides a giant sandworm and leads a holy war against the Harkonnens, with Austin Butler as Feyd-Rautha. The second part.
Pixar sequel: Riley turns 13 and new emotions Anxiety, Envy, Ennui and Embarrassment take over headquarters during a hockey camp. The sequel, not the first one.
Ryan Reynolds as Deadpool teams up with a broken variant of Wolverine (Hugh Jackman) in the Void to save his timeline from the TVA; lots of cameos.
Movie musical: green-skinned Elphaba (Cynthia Erivo) and popular Glinda (Ariana Grande) become friends at Shiz University before Elphaba turns against the Wizard of Oz; 'Defying Gravity'. Part one.
Sean Baker film: Ani, a young stripper from Brooklyn, marries the son of a Russian oligarch in Las Vegas and his family's henchmen come to get it annulled; won best picture.
Demi Moore as an ageing fitness TV star who uses a black-market drug that creates a younger version of herself (Margaret Qualley), and they must switch every seven days; body horror.
Ralph Fiennes as a cardinal running the secret vote to elect a new pope in the Vatican after the pope dies, uncovering scandals about the candidates; a twist at the end.
Michael B. Jordan plays twin brothers who open a juke joint in 1930s Mississippi, and vampires drawn by their young cousin's blues guitar lay siege to it. Ryan Coogler.
James Gunn's reboot with David Corenswet as Superman and his dog Krypto; Lex Luthor turns the public against him after he stops an invasion. Not Man of Steel.
Brad Pitt as an ageing former Formula One driver who comes back to help a struggling team and mentor a hotshot rookie; Joseph Kosinski, with Lewis Hamilton as a producer.
Paul Thomas Anderson: Leonardo DiCaprio as a burned-out ex-revolutionary who has to rescue his daughter when an old enemy, a military officer played by Sean Penn, comes after them.
Ryan Gosling as a school science teacher who wakes up alone on a spaceship with amnesia, sent to save the Sun, and befriends a spider-like alien he calls Rocky. Based on the Andy Weir novel.

Old black and white film where a judge throws his pregnant wife out because he thinks the child isn't his. The son grows up poor and becomes a petty thief. I think the girl he loves becomes his lawyer in court, maybe Dilip Kumar was the hero? There's a famous dream sequence with stairs.

Sad old film about a poor farmer who has to repay a debt to the landlord or lose his small plot of land, so he goes to Calcutta and pulls a hand rickshaw. His little son polishes shoes. Not a happy ending, I believe a factory is built on the land.

Raj Kapoor walks to Bombay singing about his japani shoes, an honest graduate who gets corrupted by a con man and a seductive woman, maybe called Maya? The famous umbrella song in the rain with Nargis.

A struggling poet nobody cares about until everyone thinks he is dead, then his poems become a hit and the publisher profits. A kind prostitute loves his poetry and helps. Black and white, very sad, Guru Dutt I think. 'jinhe naaz hai hind par' song.

Village mother struggles against a greedy moneylender after her husband loses his arms in an accident and walks out on the family. Floods, she ploughs the field herself. At the end she shoots her own rebellious son. Oscar nominated I think.

A man takes shelter in an old haveli on a stormy night and remembers his previous life on a hill estate where he loved a tribal girl, who died escaping the cruel landlord. Ghost, reincarnation, lovely songs. Not the Shah Rukh one with reincarnation.

funny old movie with three real life brothers who run a car garage. a rich girl's car breaks down in the rain at night and one of the brothers falls for her. the song ek ladki bheegi bhaagi si. kishore kumar i think

a famous film director whose career and marriage fall apart. he discovers an orphan girl and makes her a star but they can't be together. he dies alone sitting in the director's chair in an empty studio. it flopped when released but is a cult classic now, first cinemascope film in india.

Grand historical one, a Mughal prince falls in love with a court dancer and his emperor father goes to war with his own son over it. Song in a palace of mirrors. She gets bricked up in a wall at the end, or maybe she's secretly let go? Dilip Kumar and Madhubala.

Lonely wife of a rich zamindar in old Calcutta starts drinking alcohol to keep her womanizing husband at home. The story is told by a simple man who works nearby and becomes her friend. Meena Kumari was amazing. The haveli is in ruins at the start.

A rich family is torn apart by an earthquake and the three sons grow up separately, one becomes a thief, one a lawyer, and they meet again during a murder case. Multi-starrer, colour film from the 60s. 'ae meri zohra jabeen' song.

A tour guide falls for a married woman who wants to dance, makes her a star, then goes to jail for forging her signature. Later villagers mistake him for a swami and he fasts for rain until he dies. Based on an RK Narayan novel. Dev Anand.

Murder mystery set in a hill station hotel, a girl thinks the band drummer is responsible for her sister falling from the third floor. Hero dancing like crazy, RD Burman songs. Maybe Dev Anand? no, I think Shammi Kapoor.

Comedy where a simple guy falls for the girl next door, and his singer friend secretly sings from behind while he lip-syncs at the window. There's a funny South Indian music teacher rival. The singing duel 'ek chatur naar'. I think Sunil Dutt is the shy guy.

Superstar's breakthrough film: an air force pilot dies before marrying the girl, she has his son secretly and lets another family raise him, then takes the blame for a killing and goes to jail. The son grows up to be a pilot too, same actor in a double role. Song with the hero in a jeep next to a toy train in the hills.

Thriller with no songs, it all happens in one night. A painter accused of killing his wife escapes from a mental asylum and hides in a woman's house, and there's a dead body hidden in the house. Late 60s. Not the 2017 remake.

Very long movie with two intervals about a circus clown and the three women he loved in his life, his school teacher, a russian trapeze artist and a film actress. 'jeena yahan marna yahan' song. It flopped badly at the time.

A man dying of cancer is always cheerful and makes everyone around him happy, his grumpy doctor friend narrates the story. 'babu moshai' and the tape recorder playing his voice after he dies. Amitabh is the doctor, I think Rajesh Khanna is the patient.

tawaif courtesan story, a forest officer sees her feet on a train while she sleeps and leaves a note saying don't let them touch the ground. took like 14 years to make and the heroine died soon after release. 'chalte chalte' song.

Twin sisters separated at birth, one shy and abused by her cruel aunt, the other a street performer full of attitude. They swap places by accident. Hema Malini in a double role, Dharmendra is in it. Not the Sridevi one.

Light family film by hrishikesh mukherjee where a cook comes to work for a big quarrelling joint family and fixes everyone's problems, turns out he's a learned man doing this on purpose. I'm not sure but I think the girl is Jaya Bhaduri.

teenage love story, a rich boy falls for a fisherman's daughter from a christian goan family, their fathers fight and they run away. debut of the director's son. the girl wore polka dots i think. 'hum tum ek kamre mein band ho'

Angry police inspector haunted by nightmares of a white horse, because as a child he saw his parents' killer wearing a bracelet with a horse charm. A pathan gambler becomes his best friend. Made Amitabh a star. Not Deewaar.

two petty criminals are hired by a retired police officer to catch a terrible dacoit who cut off the officer's arms. the dacoit asks 'kitne aadmi the'. a chatty tonga girl dances on broken glass. i think it was the 80s.

Two brothers on opposite sides of the law, one a smuggler and one a cop. The famous line where the cop brother says he has mother. The smuggler had something tattooed on his arm as a kid about his father being a thief. He was a dock worker. Definitely not Zanjeer.

botany professor pretends to be a driver who only speaks shudh hindi to prank his wife's jija ji. another guy pretends to be the professor. hilarious hrishikesh mukherjee comedy with dharmendar and amitab bachan

Low budget devotional film from the 70s that became a huge hit, people took off their shoes in the theatre. A devoted woman prays to a new goddess, fasting on fridays, and her jealous sisters-in-law and three other goddesses make her suffer.

A poet's girlfriend marries someone else on her parents' wishes and he stops writing poetry. Twenty years later their kids fall in love and old wounds open. Title song is a poem about thoughts in the heart. I think Amitabh plays the poet.
Shy clerk in Bombay can't talk to the girl he likes at the bus stop, his smarter rival has a scooter. He goes to a retired colonel in Khandala for love coaching. Amol Palekar.

Three brothers separated as kids get raised in three different religions. The mother is blind and gets her eyesight back in a temple miracle. Famous scene where one drunk brother talks to himself in a mirror. All three give blood to their mother at the same time without knowing.

Cops replace a dead gangster boss with his exact lookalike, a simple paan-chewing village guy, and then the only cop who knew the truth dies. The paan song! The line about him being impossible to catch. The original late 70s one, not the Shah Rukh Khan remake.

An orphan boy raised by a poor woman grows up rich but the girl he worships from childhood loves his lawyer friend. A courtesan loves him. He dies at the end, tragic. 'salaam e ishq meri jaan' song. Amitabh and Rekha.

A young man lies to his strict boss that he has a twin brother, one with a moustache and one clean shaven, because the boss judges people by their moustache. Hrishikesh Mukherjee comedy. Not the Ajay Devgn series with the same name.

A pop singer keeps hearing a tune that gives him flashbacks of a previous life where his greedy wife ran him over with a car. He goes to Ooty for revenge. The 'om shanti om' song with a giant record. Early 80s Rishi Kapoor.

Extramarital affair drama, a man marries his dead brother's pregnant fiancee out of duty, then meets his old love again who is now married to a doctor. Real-life love triangle rumours with the cast. Holi song 'rang barse'. Yash Chopra.

A Tamil boy and a Hindi-speaking girl are neighbours in Goa and fall in love though they can't understand each other's language. Families force them apart for a year as a test. Very tragic ending where they jump from a cliff. Kamal Haasan's Hindi debut.

A girl is kidnapped and sold to a kotha in old Lucknow where she becomes a famous courtesan poet. Beautiful ghazals like 'dil cheez kya hai'. Rekha won a national award I believe. Not the Aishwarya remake.

Three jobless roommates in Delhi all want the new girl in the neighbourhood. Two of them brag about dating her but she actually falls for the shy studious one. She sells washing powder door to door. Early 80s comedy, not the 2013 remake.
street singer becomes a disco star, songs like 'jimmy jimmy aaja'. the villain electrifies his guitar and his mother dies of the shock. it was super popular in the soviet union. mithun da
Comedy based on Shakespeare where two pairs of twins, masters and servants, get mixed up in the same town. Sanjeev Kumar in a double role. Gulzar directed it. I'm sure there's a necklace mix-up.

A happily married man finds out he has a son from a short affair years ago. The boy's mother has died, so he brings the boy home, and his wife and daughters don't know who the boy is. Song 'lakdi ki kaathi' about a wooden horse.

Amitabh plays a railway porter at a station, the one where he got badly hurt in a fight scene during shooting and almost died. He has a pet falcon? The villain flooded the village years ago. I'm not sure but the actress is Rati Agnihotri.

Dark comedy about two struggling photographers who accidentally photograph a murder and get caught up with corrupt builders. The corpse of the commissioner keeps getting moved around and ends up in a stage play of the Mahabharata. Not Andaz Apna Apna.

An old retired headmaster in Bombay whose only son was killed in New York struggles with corrupt officials just to get his son's ashes. The actor playing the old man was actually in his twenties. Mahesh Bhatt. They have a young actress as a lodger who gets pregnant.

a guy who runs a home for orphans finds his scientist father's gadget that makes him invisible, except under red light. the villain says 'mogambo khush hua'. sridevi is a reporter. i think it was early 90s.

A divorced couple accidentally meet in a railway station waiting room on a rainy night and remember their marriage, and the free-spirited other woman who wrote poems. Song 'mera kuchh saamaan'. Gulzar film with Rekha.
In a colonial-era village a lecherous tax collector wants a strong-willed woman, she runs into a spice factory and in the end the women working there throw red chilli powder at him. Smita Patil.

Romeo and Juliet type story with two feuding families in a village, a college boy and girl run away to a jungle and both die at the end. 'papa kehte hain bada naam karega' song. Aamir Khan's first big movie, late 80s.
Anil Kapoor becomes a tapori gangster after an injustice, and the heroine's drunk father forces her to dance on stage for money. Madhuri's super famous 'ek do teen' counting song. Late 80s.

a little boy left behind by a circus ends up in Bombay's red light area delivering tea, trying to save five hundred rupees to go home to his mother. real street kids acted in it. oscar nominated, by Mira Nair.

rich boy prem falls for his father's poor friend's daughter suman. he has to work as a labourer in a quarry to prove himself. a pigeon delivers their letters, kabootar ja ja. 'dosti ka ek usool hai'. i'm sure it's salmaan's first hit.

Rich guy throws flower petals at his girlfriend from a helicopter and falls out, gets paralysed, and asks her to forget him. She moves on and works for another man who also falls for her. Yash Chopra, Switzerland songs, Sridevi in chiffon sarees.

Gangster drama in Bombay, an older brother works for a crime boss who is scared of fire, the younger brother comes back from America and his cop friend is shot among pigeons. Nana Patekar as the villain. The couple is shot on their wedding night I think.

Two brothers, one an honest police officer and the other a flashy wannabe cop who turns corrupt for money. Their mother wants revenge on the relatives who killed their father. 'one two ka four, four two ka one, my name is...' song.

A boy's honest school teacher father is lynched in their village by a drug lord, he grows up to be a gangster in Bombay seeking revenge. He says his full name with his father's name dramatically in a deep raspy voice. A South Indian coconut seller helps him. The original one, not the Hrithik remake.
College rivalry turns to love, the hero puts a rat in her room or something, her rich father hates his money-minded father. They elope and the boy gets badly hurt. Aamir and Madhuri. Not Dil Se.

late 80s or early 90s music love story, a struggling singer and an orphan girl who escaped from a hostel. the soundtrack was HUGE, nadeem shravan, 'dheere dheere se meri zindagi'. the girl becomes a model in paris. not the 2013 sequel.

A Rajput man loves an older woman who marries someone else and dies after giving birth. He looks after her daughter, who grows up looking exactly like her mother and falls in love with him. Controversial for its time, set in Rajasthan and London. Sridevi double role.

Village boy who worships his stepmother, not knowing she's scheming to grab the family property and is slowly poisoning his father. His smart wife sees through her. Madhuri's 'dhak dhak' song. I think Anil Kapoor.

College boy in a hill town, careless and flirty, his elder brother is a cycling champion who gets pushed off a building by rich school bullies, so he trains and wins the big inter-college cycle race. 'pehla nasha' song in slow motion. Aamir khan. Not a cricket movie.

The hero is actually the villain, he pushes his girlfriend off a rooftop and then romances her sister, all for revenge against their father who ruined his family. The line about one who wins by losing. 90s, shahrukh with kajol.
obsessive stalker keeps calling the girl, he stutters her name like k-k-k... her fiance is a navy commando played by sunny deol. switzerland honeymoon chase. yash chopra.

Sanjay Dutt plays a dangerous criminal who escapes custody, and the police inspector's girlfriend goes undercover as a folk dancer to catch him. Very controversial 'choli ke peeche kya hai' song. Jackie Shroff is the inspector.

A woman from a rich family sees her brother-in-law and his friends rape their maid during Holi and decides to testify against her own family. A drunk lawyer helps her in court, famous dialogue about 'tareekh pe tareekh' and his heavy hand. Sunny Deol.

Basically a long family wedding video with 14 songs. The heroine's elder sister marries the hero's elder brother, then she falls down the stairs and dies, and the families decide the younger sister should marry the widower. The pet dog Tuffy saves the day with a letter. No villain at all.

two lazy small-town guys both try to trap a rich London heiress, turns out the girls swapped identities. villain crime master gogo and 'teja main hoon, mark idhar hai'. salman and aamir together. flopped in theatres but cult now.

Love story during the freedom struggle against the British, the son of a loyal officer falls for a revolutionary's daughter in a hill town. RD Burman's last music, 'ek ladki ko dekha toh aisa laga'. They plan to blow up a British general. Set in the 40s but released in the 90s.

a newspaper owner frees a man from jail and uses him as a pawn to kill drug dealers, but the rich man is the real villain. 'tip tip barsa paani' in the rain with raveena, and 'tu cheez badi hai mast'. akshay plays a cop.

Shah Rukh as a lovable loser in Goa who plays in a band, fails his exams, and loves a girl who loves his friend in the band. He even lies to break them up. He doesn't get the girl in the end, which is rare. Christian family, church scenes.

NRI boy and girl meet on a Europe trip, she's engaged to someone in Punjab, he follows her to India to win over her strict father instead of eloping. Pigeons in London, mustard fields, the train at the end where the father lets her go. I think the girl was Madhuri. Please help, my mom wants to watch it.

Two brothers are murdered by their greedy uncle, their mother keeps praying they'll come back, and they get reborn in different places and later remember their past life. Salman and Shah Rukh in the 90s. Not Om Shanti Om.

Girl dreams of being a film star, her childhood friend is a street-smart guy who sells movie tickets in black and wears loud yellow clothes, and a superstar actor falls for her too. A.R. Rahman music, Urmila dancing. RGV.

Rich girl falls for a simple taxi driver in a hill station, the famous long kiss, her scheming stepmother separates them and they fight over their son. 'pardesi pardesi jaana nahi'. I'm not sure but I think Aamir Khan.

Set during the Punjab insurgency, a young man joins militants after his friend is tortured by police. His girlfriend, played by Tabu, follows him. Ends with a cyanide pill. Gulzar's songs like 'chhod aaye hum'.

A theatre director believes there's someone made for everyone, his dancer friend secretly loves him but breaks her leg, and the new dancer turns out to be the girl of his dreams. Dance academy, the dance of envy. Shah Rukh, Madhuri and Karisma.
War movie about a small Indian army post in the Rajasthan desert holding off Pakistani tanks all night in 1971. Sunny Deol roaring. Emotional song about letters from home, 'sandese aate hain'.

College guy picks the hot new girl over his tomboy best friend. The wife dies after giving birth and leaves 8 letters for her daughter, who then plays matchmaker at a summer camp years later. 'pyaar dosti hai'. Basketball scenes.

Gritty Mumbai underworld film, an unknown man arrives in the city, ends up in jail and joins a gangster's gang, the loud gangster friend Bhiku shouts 'mumbai ka king kaun'. Very realistic, late 90s. RGV.

A radio journalist falls obsessively for a mysterious woman who turns out to be part of a terrorist group planning a suicide bombing in Delhi. Dancing on top of a moving train! Mani Ratnam, AR Rahman. Ends with both of them blowing up.
Small-time boxer working for a goon in Bombay, the dare where boys run towards an oncoming train at night. 'aati kya khandala' song. His brother betrayed someone in the past. Aamir and Rani.

A music student from Italy falls for his guru's daughter in Gujarat but she's married off to a lawyer. The husband finds out she loves someone else and takes her to Italy to reunite them, but she chooses him in the end. Garba songs. Aishwarya, Salman, Ajay Devgn.
Honest police officer fights cross-border arms smuggling in Rajasthan and the mastermind is a famous Pakistani ghazal singer he admires. Late 90s. Aamir as an ACP.

Big perfect joint family where the eldest son is a stepson, jealous relatives convince the mother to send him away, like the Ramayana. Lots of songs and sarees. Salman, Saif, Karisma, Tabu, Sonali. The blackbuck hunting case happened during the shoot.

Rich city boy falls for a folk singer's daughter in the Himachal hills, his father insults her family, and she becomes a pop star with a famous music producer. AR Rahman songs, 'ishq bina kya jeena yaaron'.
Hritik's debut where he plays a singer who is killed after witnessing a murder, and then the girl meets his exact lookalike in New Zealand. The 'ek pal ka jeena' dance steps everyone copied. 2000.

three broke guys living in a garage get a wrong number call from kidnappers and try to steal the ransom. 'utha le re deva' and the old landlord with thick glasses, baburao. comedy. not phir hera pheri the sequel.

Villagers in British India are challenged to a cricket match to get out of paying three times the tax during a drought. The British officer's sister secretly teaches them the rules. Oscar nominated. Not Iqbal.

three rich college friends go on a road trip to Goa after graduating, one has a goatee, the quiet artist falls in love with an older divorced woman who drinks and later dies. sydney opera house. the friends fall out and reunite.

Adopted son of a rich businessman marries a girl from Chandni Chowk, his dad throws him out, they move to London. Years later the younger brother goes undercover in their house to bring them home. National anthem scene at a school. Big multi-starrer, early 2000s.

During partition, a Sikh truck driver saves a Muslim girl from rioters and marries her. Her father, now a mayor in Lahore, takes her back, so he goes into Pakistan to get her. He pulls a hand pump out of the ground in anger! Early 2000s, not the 2023 sequel.

Rich zamindar's son comes back from London, can't marry his childhood love Paro because of family pride, becomes an alcoholic and goes to a courtesan, Chandramukhi. Lavish sets, 'dola re dola' dance. He dies in front of her house gate. The 2002 one, not the black and white.
Two partners in the Mumbai mafia become enemies, one runs things from abroad, inspired by real dons. Ajay Devgn with very little dialogue. Item song 'khallas'. RGV, early 2000s. Vivek Oberoi's debut.

A mentally challenged young man uses his late scientist father's computer to call aliens, and a blue alien named Jaadu gives him powers and intelligence. Basketball match. Not Krrish but the one before it.

Set in New York, a cheerful guy with a heart condition helps a serious girl and her family's restaurant, she falls for him but he pushes her towards his friend because he's dying. 'it's the time to disco', gujju jokes. Preity Zinta.

A Mumbai gangster with a big heart joins medical college to make his father proud, his sidekick is called Circuit. He gives everyone a 'jadoo ki jhappi', a magic hug. The dean laughs nervously. Not the sequel with Gandhi.

Shakespeare's Macbeth set in the Mumbai underworld. The right hand man of an old don is pushed by the don's mistress to kill him. Two corrupt policemen predict the future like the witches. Irrfan and Tabu.

Student politics in Allahabad university, a simple student gets caught between two goons fighting over the college elections, Irrfan's villain role was legendary. Early 2000s, slow but gritty. I think Jimmy Shergill was the student.

An Indian air force pilot falls for a Pakistani girl, gets locked in a Pakistani jail under a false name for 22 years. A young Pakistani lawyer fights his case. Yash Chopra, songs made from old Madan Mohan tunes.

Army officer goes undercover as a college student to protect the general's daughter and also find his half-brother. He falls for the chemistry teacher, played by Sushmita Sen. Villain is an ex-soldier against peace with Pakistan. Farah Khan.

A NASA scientist comes back to India to take his old nanny to America and ends up building a small electricity generator for her village. The scene where a poor boy sells water for 25 paise at a train station. Slow but beautiful. Shah Rukh.

Superbike gang robs banks in Mumbai and escapes on fast motorcycles. A cop teams up with a mechanic who's into bikes. The gang leader has long hair. Title song everyone played. John Abraham as the villain.

Docu-drama about the 1993 Bombay bomb blasts and the police investigation, based on a book. A long chase through the slums. Kay Kay Menon as the police officer. Banned for a couple of years before release.

A deaf and blind girl in Shimla and her alcoholic teacher who teaches her language, later he gets Alzheimer's and she teaches him. Inspired by Helen Keller. Dark blue and black colours everywhere. Amitabh and Rani.

College friends in Delhi act in a British girl's documentary about freedom fighters like Bhagat Singh and Azad, then their pilot friend dies in a MiG crash and they take revenge on the corrupt minister. Ends at a radio station. I think Aamir and Siddharth.
the gangster with a sidekick named circuit starts seeing mahatma gandhi and uses gandhigiri to help people. he falls for a radio jockey. not the medical college one.

Indian superhero with a black mask who has powers inherited from his father's alien friend. Fights a scientist building a machine that shows the future, in Singapore. Priyanka Chopra. Not the first one with the blue alien.

Master thief in disguises steals priceless things across the world and teams up with a female thief he falls for. Rio de Janeiro. The bike-riding cops are back. Hrithik and Aishwarya kiss. Not the first one with John Abraham.

Shakespeare's Othello set among gangsters in rural Uttar Pradesh, Saif Ali Khan plays the jealous lame guy, Langda Tyagi. 'beedi jalaile' item song. The bride is murdered by her husband over a lost waist-band.

Middle-class retired man in Delhi buys a plot of land but a builder grabs it, so his son and a group of theatre actors con the builder with a fake property deal. Boman Irani plays the land shark. Funny and very Delhi.

Disgraced former hockey player branded a traitor coaches the Indian women's hockey team made of girls from different states who fight each other. The seventy minutes speech. Not a cricket movie. Shah Rukh.
8 year old boy who can't read and keeps failing is sent to a boarding school, an art teacher realizes he has dyslexia. Painting competition at the end. Aamir is the teacher, I'm sure.

a junior artist in 70s bollywood loves a superstar actress, she is killed by her producer husband in a set fire, he dies too and is reborn as a superstar's son 30 years later, who takes revenge with her ghost. Deepika's debut. Lots of film industry jokes.

Depressed rich guy gets on a random train and meets a super talkative Punjabi girl who is running away to marry her boyfriend. They get stuck in a small town at night, maybe it was a bus? She says she is her own favourite. Shahid and Kareena.

An NRI couple moves into a haunted palace in Rajasthan, the wife gets possessed by the spirit of a dancer called Manjulika, and a quirky psychiatrist solves it, it's a mental disorder. 'ami je tomar' dance. The original, not the Kartik Aaryan sequel.

A rich music producer invites an annoying tax officer who loves singing to a dinner where they make fun of idiots, but the idiot ends up ruining his life in one night. Small budget comedy. Vinay Pathak.

A rich businessman can't remember anything for more than 15 minutes after a head injury, so he tattoos clues on his body and uses polaroid photos to hunt down the man who killed his girlfriend. Aamir with a shaved head. Not the Christopher Nolan film.

A common man calls the Mumbai police commissioner saying he has planted bombs across the city, and demands four terrorists be released. It all happens in one afternoon. Twist at the end, Naseeruddin Shah.

Historical romance about a Mughal emperor marrying a Rajput princess for political reasons, and slowly falling in love. Sword fight between husband and wife. 'khwaja mere khwaja' qawwali. Hrithik and Aishwarya.
Four friends had a rock band in college that broke up, ten years later they're sad corporate guys and reunite for a competition. The guitarist's wife is upset and he gets sick. Farhan Akhtar sings.
Based on a real Delhi super-thief, a charming Punjabi guy steals TVs and cars from rich houses since childhood. Paresh Rawal plays three different roles. Abhay Deol.

Modern take on the Devdas story set in Punjab and Delhi with drugs and alcohol, the courtesan character is a schoolgirl who had a leaked sex video scandal. Song 'emotional atyachaar' by a brass band. Not the Shah Rukh one.

engineering college friends, the genius one questions rote learning, the strict director is called Virus, a funny speech where a nerd's speech is changed with rude hindi words, and they deliver a baby using a vacuum cleaner. 'all izz well'.
Twin brothers, one lisps and one stutters, both get mixed up with a guitar case full of cocaine and gangsters in one day in Mumbai. Shahid Kapoor in a double role. 'dhan te nan' song.
Spoiled lazy rich boy in Mumbai fails his college exams, fights with his dad, and moves in with an older woman from Calcutta who's a writer. He becomes a photographer. Ranbir and Konkona.

A Muslim man with Asperger's syndrome travels across America to tell the President that he is not a terrorist, after his stepson is killed in a hate crime after 9/11. Hurricane scene. Kajol and Shah Rukh.
Corrupt but funny police inspector in a small UP town who tucks his sunglasses in his collar, fights the local goon politician. 'munni badnaam hui' item song. Salman, early 2010s.

Teenage boy expelled from boarding school goes back to his strict abusive father in an industrial town, and finds out he has a little half-brother. He wants to be a writer, not an engineer. They run away at the end.

Satire about a poor farmer in debt who agrees to commit suicide so his family gets government compensation money, and the TV media turns his village into a circus. 'mehngai dayan' song. Produced by Aamir Khan.
A Delhi college boy and a girl start a wedding planning business together and agree not to mix business with romance, which they obviously do. Ranveer Singh's first film.

Three school friends go on a bachelor road trip across Spain, each picks a dangerous sport, deep sea diving, skydiving and the running of the bulls. Tomato festival. Poems in Farhan's voice. Katrina is a diving instructor.

Three messy roommates in Delhi accidentally swap a stool sample with a package of smuggled diamonds and get chased by gangsters. Lots of swearing, mostly in English. 'DK Bose' song. Produced by Aamir.

A simple Delhi college boy wants to be a rock star and believes he needs heartbreak, falls for a girl who marries and moves to Prague. He becomes an angry famous singer. 'sadda haq'. AR Rahman, Ranbir.
Biopic inspired by a South Indian adult film actress of the 80s who becomes a sensation and then falls apart. Vidya Balan won awards for it. 'ooh la la'.
true story of an army soldier who was a national champion in steeplechase running, and later becomes a rebel dacoit in the Chambal ravines over a land dispute. 'beehad mein baaghi hote hain'. Irrfan.

A pregnant woman from London arrives in Kolkata during Durga Puja to find her missing husband, no one has heard of him. Big twist at the end about the pregnancy. Bob Biswas the creepy insurance agent killer.

Revenge saga across three generations in the coal mines of Dhanbad, a man swears revenge against the politician who killed his father. Two parts, very violent, 'keh ke lunga' and Nawazuddin. Songs like 'womaniya'.

a deaf and mute charming guy in Darjeeling falls for a girl who's engaged, and later takes care of an autistic girl from a rich family who he is accused of kidnapping. Charlie Chaplin-like comedy. Ranbir and Priyanka.
Comedy about a Punjabi guy in Delhi convinced by an infertility doctor to become a sperm donor, then he marries a Bengali girl who can't have kids. Ayushmann's first film.
A housewife who makes laddoos is teased by her husband and daughter for not speaking English, goes to New York for her niece's wedding and secretly takes an English class. Sridevi's comeback.
An atheist shopkeeper's shop is destroyed in an earthquake and insurance won't pay because it's an act of God, so he sues God in court. Akshay Kumar plays Krishna. The first one, not the 2023 sequel.

Con men pose as CBI officers and carry out fake raids on rich businessmen and politicians in the 1980s. Based on the real Opera House heist. Akshay Kumar and Anupam Kher. Manoj Bajpayee is a real CBI guy chasing them.
Three friends in Ahmedabad start a cricket shop and academy, train a talented Muslim boy, and their friendship breaks during the Gujarat riots. Based on a Chetan Bhagat book. Sushant Singh Rajput.
Biopic of the Flying Sikh, the runner who lost his family in partition and lost an Olympic medal by looking back. Farhan Akhtar's ripped body. A race in Pakistan.

Period romance in 1950s Bengal, a con man posing as an archaeologist falls for the zamindar's daughter, robs her family and disappears. Later she's dying of TB in Dalhousie and he paints the last leaf on a tree. Ranveer and Sonakshi.

A lonely housewife's lunchbox is delivered to the wrong man by Mumbai's dabbawalas, a widower about to retire, and they start writing letters to each other in the tiffin. Irrfan. Quiet film, there were no songs.

Nerdy girl goes on a trekking trip to Manali with old school friends and falls for the guy who wants to travel the world. Eight years later they meet at a friend's wedding in Udaipur. 'badtameez dil'. Ranbir and Deepika.

A guy is supposed to take his grandfather's ashes to Rameswaram, instead he gets on a train with a runaway Tamil girl and her goon cousins. Lungi dance! 'don't underestimate the power of a common man'. Rohit Shetty comedy. Thanks in advance!
A shy Punjabi girl from Delhi is dumped by her fiance a day before the wedding, so she goes on her honeymoon to Paris and Amsterdam alone and finds herself. Kangana. Funny and sweet.

Shakespeare's Hamlet set in 1990s Kashmir during the insurgency. A young man returns home to find his doctor father missing and his mother close to his uncle. 'bismil' song performance. Shahid shaves his head.

An alien lands in Rajasthan and loses the remote to his spaceship, wanders around asking questions about god and religion, calls godmen a 'wrong number'. Big ears, dancing car. A TV journalist helps him. Aamir Khan.
A simple Hanuman devotee finds a lost little mute girl from Pakistan and takes her back across the border illegally. A funny Pakistani reporter helps him. Salman Khan.

A grumpy old Bengali father obsessed with his constipation and his daughter take a road trip from Delhi to Kolkata, driven by the owner of a taxi company. Funny and touching. Deepika, Amitabh and Irrfan.

Two stories in Varanasi: a boy from a family that burns bodies at the ghats falls for an upper caste girl who dies in an accident, and a woman blackmailed by a cop after being caught with her boyfriend. Vicky Kaushal's debut.
Based on the real Noida double murder case of a teenage girl and the family's servant, told from different points of view like Rashomon. Irrfan Khan is the investigating officer.

A cable TV operator who loves watching movies protects his family after his daughter accidentally kills a boy who was blackmailing her. He creates a fake alibi using a trip on 2nd October. The body is hidden under a new police station. Ajay Devgn. Not the sequel.

Historical love story of a Maratha warrior general who falls for a half-Muslim warrior princess, while his first wife suffers. A mirror palace song like Mughal-e-Azam. Ranveer, Deepika and Priyanka. Sanjay Leela Bhansali.

In 90s Haridwar, a school dropout who runs a cassette shop is forced to marry an educated overweight girl. Their marriage is in trouble until they enter a race where husbands carry their wives. Kumar Sanu songs.

Two strangers meet in Corsica and agree to pretend to be other people with no real names. Years later in Delhi she finds him boring as a corporate robot, and he has a breakdown. He loved stories as a child. Ranbir and Deepika again.

Former wrestler in a Haryana village wants a son to win gold for India, but has daughters, so he trains them in wrestling and they become champions. Commonwealth Games final. 'mhari chhoriyan chhoron se kam hai ke'. Aamir gained weight for it.

Three working women in Delhi are framed after one of them hits a powerful man who tried to molest her. A retired lawyer with bipolar disorder defends them in court and argues that no means no. Amitabh.
True story of a young flight attendant who saved passengers when her plane was hijacked by terrorists in Karachi in the 80s, she died protecting children. Sonam Kapoor.
Drug addiction crisis in Punjab, four stories: a coke-addicted pop star, a Bihari girl who finds a packet of heroin in the field, a cop and a doctor. Big censorship fight. Alia without makeup.
Biopic of the Indian cricket captain from Ranchi who worked as a ticket collector at a railway station before making it. His girlfriend dies in an accident. Helicopter shot. Sushant Singh Rajput.

Two brothers come home to Coonoor after their 90 year old grandfather has a heart attack, he wants a family photo, and the dysfunctional family's secrets come out, the perfect brother is gay. Rishi Kapoor with heavy makeup as the naughty grandpa.

An idealistic government clerk is sent to run an election booth in a Naxal-affected jungle in Chhattisgarh, and the security officer guarding them thinks it's pointless. Dark comedy, Rajkummar Rao. India's Oscar entry.

A free-spirited small-town girl reads a novel whose heroine is just like her and goes looking for the author, but the real writer is a printing press owner who used his shy friend's name and photo. Rajkummar Rao is hilarious.

pianist pretends to be blind to get gigs and witnesses a murder in an old actor's flat, the actor's wife (tabu) did it. a rabbit and a liver at the end. dark comedy thriller. i think it was 2016 or 2017.

Horror comedy in a small town where a female ghost abducts men at night during a festival, people write 'come tomorrow' on their walls to keep her away. A ladies' tailor falls for a mysterious girl. Rajkummar Rao. Not the 2024 sequel.
A grown up son is embarrassed when his middle-aged mother gets pregnant, the whole Delhi family and neighbours gossip. The grandma steals the show. Ayushmann Khurrana comedy.

A young Kashmiri girl becomes a spy for India and marries into a Pakistani army officer's family before the 1971 war. Morse code, and she has to kill people in the house. Alia Bhatt. Based on a true story.

Historical epic about a Rajput queen and the sultan Alauddin Khilji who becomes obsessed with her beauty and lays siege to the fort. She and the women do jauhar at the end. Ranveer as the crazy villain. Huge protests before release.
Biopic of a Bollywood actor's troubled life, drug addiction, his mother dying of cancer, and the arms possession case and jail. His Gujarati best friend from America. Ranbir transformed completely.

Dark folk horror in rainy colonial Maharashtra, a man's family secretly gets gold coins from a cursed demon god trapped in the womb of a goddess. The scary grandmother with a tree growing out of her body.
Army officer leads surgical strikes into Pakistan after a terrorist attack on an army camp. 'How's the josh?' 'High sir!' Vicky Kaushal. A Garuda drone.
a boy from the Dharavi slums becomes a street rapper, his doctor girlfriend is very possessive and hits a girl with a bottle. 'apna time aayega'. based on Naezy and Divine. Ranveer Singh.
Big-city police officer is posted to a village in UP where two Dalit girls are found hanging from a tree, and he fights the caste system to solve the case. Ayushmann. Based on real events.

Hindi remake of a Telugu film, an angry brilliant surgeon goes on a self-destructive spree with alcohol and drugs after his girlfriend is married off. Very controversial for toxic masculinity. Shahid Kapoor. Not the original Telugu one.
Spy action where a top agent goes rogue and his student is sent to hunt him down, crazy car and plane chases across the world. The two of them dance together in one song. Hrithik and Tiger Shroff.

After his son tries to kill himself over failing an entrance exam, a father gathers his old engineering hostel friends and tells the story of how they were called losers and still fought in the college sports championship. Sushant Singh Rajput, 2019.
Dacoit gang in the Chambal ravines during the emergency in the 70s, being hunted by police, they help a woman and a little girl escape. Sushant and Manoj Bajpayee. Rustic dialogues. Not Sholay.
Historical action about a Maratha warrior who recaptures a fort from the Mughals by climbing a cliff with a monitor lizard. Saif plays the cruel villain Udaybhan. Ajay Devgn. 3D.
A happy housewife's husband slaps her once in front of everyone at a party, and she decides to leave him and ask for a divorce, because just one slap is not ok. Taapsee Pannu.
Biopic of a Kargil war hero, a young captain whose victory signal was 'yeh dil maange more', he dies on a peak saving a soldier. His girlfriend never married. Sidharth Malhotra.
Slow biopic of the revolutionary who went to London and shot the former governor of Punjab, revenge for the Jallianwala Bagh massacre. The long massacre scene near the end is haunting. Vicky Kaushal.
Ranveer Singh plays the captain of the underdog Indian cricket team that won the world cup in England, the 175 not out innings. Nobody gave them a chance.
Controversial film about the exodus of Kashmiri Pandits in 1990, a young student learns the truth about how his family was killed, his grandfather played by Anupam Kher. Huge box office hit in 2022.

A young girl from Gujarat is sold to a brothel in Mumbai's red light area by her boyfriend and rises to become its powerful madam who fights for sex workers' rights. Alia Bhatt in white sarees. Sanjay Leela Bhansali.

Fantasy about ancient magical weapons called astras, a DJ discovers he can't be burnt by fire and is linked to the most powerful one. Shah Rukh has a cameo as a scientist. Ranbir and Alia, lots of VFX. Part one of a trilogy.
Horror comedy where a guy pretends to be a psychic called Rooh Baba and stays in a haunted haveli with the ghost Manjulika locked in a room. Tabu plays twins. Not the Akshay Kumar original.

Shah Rukh's comeback spy film, an exiled agent fights a former Indian agent turned terrorist played by John Abraham who plans a virus attack. Salman Khan's cameo on a train. Deepika's orange swimsuit song controversy.

Shah Rukh with a bald head and bandaged face hijacks a Mumbai metro train with a gang of women from a prison to demand money for farmers. Father-son double role. Directed by a Tamil director, Nayanthara is the cop.
Sequel where the Sikh truck driver goes to Pakistan again, this time to rescue his son during the 1971 war, picks up a cart wheel to fight. Sunny Deol. Not the first one from 2001.

Extremely violent film about a son obsessed with his rich father's love who goes on a bloody revenge spree, with a giant machine gun scene. The mute villain dances with a glass on his head. Ranbir Kapoor. Same director as Kabir Singh.

True story of a poor boy from Chambal who failed 12th class because cheating was stopped, goes to Delhi, works in a flour mill while preparing for the UPSC exam and becomes an IPS officer. 'restart'. Vikrant Massey.
