query: Loud rich Punjabi guy and an intellectual Bengali TV journalist fall in love and decide to live with each other's families for three months before marrying. The grandfather's old love story with old songs. Karan Johar, 2023.

Friends from a small Punjab village can't get UK visas so they take the illegal 'donkey route' through deserts and countries to reach London. Shah Rukh is a soldier who helps them. Rajkumar Hirani. Bittersweet.

Two newlywed brides wearing long veils get swapped on a crowded train in a village in 2001, one is lost at a railway station and the other has secret plans. Funny and feminist. Kiran Rao, India's Oscar entry.
Sequel to the horror comedy about the female ghost, now a headless demon is abducting modern women from the town of Chanderi. Rajkummar Rao and Shraddha. Huge hit in 2024.
Almost the entire film happens on a train: an army commando fights 40 bandits who rob the passengers, after they kill his girlfriend. Extremely violent, no songs. 2024, Lakshya was the lead.

Historical film about Shivaji's son, the Maratha king who fought Aurangzeb and was tortured to death without giving up. Vicky Kaushal roaring like a lion. Akshaye Khanna as Aurangzeb. Released in 2025.

amitabh and Shashi Kapoor play conman brothers whose honest cop brother Sunil Dutt is killed by Shakaal, the bald villain who runs his gang from a high-tech island. Shatrughan Sinha is a circus sharpshooter. 'Yamma yamma' and 'pyar karne wale' songs. Ramesh Sippy, around 1978 I think.

Amitabh Bachchan is the eldest of seven rowdy orphan brothers living on a farm, and Hema Malini is the nurse Indu who marries him and civilises them. Amitabh also plays Babu, a criminal lookalike. Based on Seven Brides for Seven Brothers I think. 'Pyar hamein kis mod pe le aaya' song.

Rishi Kapoor as Devdhar, a poor orphan educated with the thakur's help, who loves the thakur's niece Rama (Padmini Kolhapure). She is married to a rich prince, becomes a widow days later and her family treats her like a cursed widow. Directed by Raj Kapoor, Shammi Kapoor as Bade Raja. 'Bhanwre ne khilaya phool' song.

Sunny Deol's debut film: he is a poor happy farm boy living with his mother and his dog, and Amrita Singh (her debut too) is the arrogant rich girl Roma whose father turned his back on his family. 'Jab hum jawan honge' song, and a valley in Kashmir got named after this film.

Kamal Haasan, Rishi Kapoor and maybe Sridevi in a love triangle in Goa: she runs a small restaurant, Raja silently loves her, but she falls for rich Ravi who is back from America and whose grandmother opposes it, and Raja sacrifices himself. 'Chehra hai ya chand khila hai' song. Ramesh Sippy, mid 80s.

Dilip Kumar plays a jailer who picks three convicts, Jackie Shroff, Anil Kapoor and Naseeruddin Shah, to fight Dr. Dang (Anupam Kher), the terrorist who blew up his jail and killed his sons. 'Har karam apna karenge' song. Subhash Ghai, 1986, and Dang's line about the slap.

Sridevi as Rajni, an ichchhadhari naagin who marries Rishi Kapoor, and Amrish Puri as the evil sadhu Bhairo Nath who killed her snake husband for his gem and now wants to trap her. The famous 'main teri dushman, dushman tu mera' snake dance. 1986.

Basu Chatterjee's Hindi remake of 12 Angry Men: twelve jurors in one room deciding whether a slum boy stabbed his father. K. K. Raina is juror number 8 who keeps doubting and Pankaj Kapur is the angry one. 1986.

amitab bachan as Inspector Vijay, who acts like a cowardly bribe-taking cop by day and at night becomes a masked vigilante with a metal sleeve on his arm, to avenge his father who hanged himself after being framed. 'Rishte mein toh hum tumhare baap lagte hain' dialogue. Meenakshi Sheshadri, Amrish Puri as JK. Late 80s.

Sridevi in a double role as twins Anju and Manju separated at birth: Anju is the timid one tortured by her uncle Tribhuvan (Anupam Kher) and Manju is the fiery slum girl, and they swap places. Sunny Deol and Rajinikanth. Famous rain song 'na jaane kahan se aayi hai'. 1989.

Sanjay Dutt as Ravi, a taxi driver with insomnia, rescues Pooja Bhatt from a brothel run by the terrifying eunuch Maharani played by Sadashiv Amrapurkar. Mahesh Bhatt, 1991. 'Tumhein apna banane ki kasam' song. Not the 2020 sequel.

ajay devgan's debut with his entry balancing on two moving motorbikes. He is the son of underworld don Nageshwar (Amrish Puri), wants nothing to do with crime, and the rival gang kidnaps his baby son. Madhoo is his wife. 'Dheere dheere pyar ko badhana hai' song.

Gulzar's ghost story: Vinod Khanna is a government officer sent to make an inventory of an old Rajasthan haveli and keeps meeting Reva (Dimple Kapadia), a spirit trapped in the past. 'Yaara seeli seeli' song; I think Lata Mangeshkar produced it.

Akshay Kumar as Raj, a college prankster who never loses a bet. He and his friends (Ayesha Jhulka, Deepak Tijori) fake the kidnapping of their rich friend Sheetal, then she turns up dead with a knife in her back. Abbas-Mustan, 1992. 'Wada raha sanam' song.

David Dhawan comedy with Govinda in a double role as the lazy prankster Bunnu and his simple village lookalike cousin Gauri Shankar, with Chunky Pandey as his brother Munnu. 'O lal dupatte wali' song. Not the 2002 Amitabh heist film.
Shekhar Kapur's biopic of Phoolan Devi, played by Seema Biswas: child bride, abused by the thakurs, joins a dacoit gang with Vikram Mallah and takes revenge at Behmai. Very violent, mid 90s.

Akshay Kumar as Inspector Karan and Saif Ali Khan as the film star Deepak who tags along to learn real police work for a role, and they fight the drug lord Goli (Shakti Kapoor). Shilpa Shetty in a double role. 'Chura ke dil mera goriya chali' song.

Sanjay Leela Bhansali's first film: Nana Patekar and Seema Biswas are a deaf and mute couple in Goa, and their daughter Annie (Manisha Koirala) loves singing and falls for Salman Khan. 'Aaj main upar' and 'baahon ke darmiyan' songs. Mid 90s.

Sunny Deol as Kashi, a wrestler from Banaras who brings his freedom-fighter father (Amrish Puri) to Bombay for treatment and takes on the gangster Katya (Danny Denzongpa) and his six brothers. Rajkumar Santoshi. 'Koi jaye to le aaye' song.

Kajol as clumsy Sanjana from Paris who is scared of flying and follows her cheating fiance to India; Ajay Devgn is the thief Shekhar who hides a diamond necklace in her bag, and Om Puri is the inspector after him. Late 90s remake of French Kiss.

R. Madhavan as Maddy, a college rowdy who falls for Reena (Dia Mirza) and pretends to be her NRI fiance Rajeev, who is actually his old college rival Sam (Saif Ali Khan). Remake of Minnale. 'Zara zara behekta hai' song.

Ajay Devgn as Bhagat Singh with Sushant Singh as Sukhdev: Jallianwala Bagh, throwing the bomb in the assembly, the hunger strike in jail, hanged at 23. Rajkumar Santoshi, 2002, not the Bobby Deol one that came out the same year.

Vivek Oberoi and Rani Mukerji marry secretly against their families, then fight after moving in together and she goes missing after an accident. Shaad Ali's remake of Alaipayuthey. 'Chhalka chhalka re' song, A. R. Rahman music.

Bipasha Basu and Dino Morea horror: a couple go to a bungalow in Ooty to save their marriage and it is haunted by Malini, the girl he had an affair with who shot herself. Ashutosh Rana as the professor. 'Aapke pyaar mein hum savarne lage' song. Not the old 1981 one.

salmaan khan with that famous long middle-parted hair as Radhe, a college goon who falls for the priest's daughter Nirjara (Bhumika Chawla), goes mad after being beaten and ends up chained in a temple asylum. 'Kyun kisi ko wafa ke badle' song.

Shreyas Talpade as a deaf and mute village boy who dreams of bowling for India, trained by a drunk former cricketer (Naseeruddin Shah) and practising with his buffaloes as fielders. Nagesh Kukunoor, 2005.

Rohit Shetty comedy with Ajay Devgn, Arshad Warsi, Tusshar Kapoor (who can't speak) and Sharman Joshi hiding in the house of a blind old couple (Paresh Rawal and Sushmita Mukherjee) by pretending one of them is their grandson. Not the 1979 Amol Palekar one.

Karan Johar film set in New York: Shah Rukh Khan is a footballer whose career ends in an accident and Rani Mukerji is unhappily married to Abhishek Bachchan, and they start an affair. Amitabh is the flirty father Sam and Preity Zinta the wife. Not Kuch Kuch Hota Hai.

Abbas-Mustan twisty thriller in South Africa: Saif Ali Khan runs horse racing stables in Durban, his alcoholic brother Akshaye Khanna plots to kill him for the insurance, and Anil Kapoor is the fruit-eating detective RD. Bipasha and Katrina. 'Zara zara touch me' song. The first one, not Race 2.

Imtiaz Ali film: Saif Ali Khan as Jai, who amicably breaks up with Meera (Deepika Padukone) in London, while Rishi Kapoor narrates his own old love story, with Saif also playing him as a young Sikh boy. 'Twist' and 'chor bazaari' songs. The 2009 one, not the 2020 remake.

Naseeruddin Shah and Arshad Warsi as Khalujan and Babban, two crooks hiding in a Gorakhpur village with the gangster's widow Krishna (Vidya Balan), who seduces both of them into her kidnapping plan. 'Dil to bachcha hai ji' and 'ibn-e-batuta' songs.

sharukh as Don in the sequel: he surrenders in Malaysia, breaks out of prison with Vardhaan and robs the currency printing plates from a bank in Berlin; Priyanka Chopra as Roma, now with Interpol. Farhan Akhtar. Not the first Don.

Yash Chopra's last film: Shah Rukh Khan is Major Samar Anand, an army bomb disposal expert who never wears a bomb suit, and Anushka Sharma is the Discovery Channel filmmaker reading his diary about his London romance with Katrina Kaif. 'Challa' song.

Aamir Khan as Inspector Surjan Shekhawat investigating a film star's car crash into the sea in Mumbai while he and his wife (Rani Mukerji) grieve their drowned son; Kareena Kapoor is Rosie, the mysterious escort who turns out to be a ghost. Nawazuddin as Tehmur.

Aamir Khan plays twins Sahir and Samar who run a circus in Chicago and rob the bank that ruined their father (Jackie Shroff); Abhishek Bachchan and Uday Chopra come as Jai and Ali, and Katrina Kaif is the acrobat. Not the first or the second one.

Arjun Kapoor as Krish, a Punjabi boy from Delhi, and Alia Bhatt as Ananya, a Tamil Brahmin girl, meet at IIM Ahmedabad and try to win over each other's families. Based on Chetan Bhagat's novel. 'Locha-e-ulfat' song.

Akshay Kumar leads a secret counter-terror unit set up after 26/11, with Taapsee Pannu and Danny Denzongpa as his boss; they extract the terrorist mastermind from Saudi Arabia. Neeraj Pandey, 2015. Not A Wednesday.

Ranbir Kapoor as Ayan, a singer who falls for his best friend Alizeh (Anushka Sharma) in London and Paris while she still loves her ex Ali (Fawad Khan); Aishwarya Rai is the poet Saba. 'Channa mereya' and 'bulleya' songs. Karan Johar.

Akshay Kumar as Lakshmikant Chauhan who invents a cheap sanitary pad machine for his wife Gayatri (Radhika Apte) and the women of his village, based on Arunachalam Muruganantham; Sonam Kapoor plays Pari who helps him. R. Balki.

Ayushmann Khurrana as Bala, a fairness-cream salesman from Kanpur who is going bald early and hides it with a wig to marry the model Pari (Yami Gautam); Bhumi Pednekar is the dark-skinned lawyer Latika. 2019.

Anurag Basu's Netflix anthology where four stories meet through the gangster Sattu (Pankaj Tripathi): Abhishek Bachchan as Bittu, Rajkummar Rao as Alu who loves Pinky (Fatima Sana Shaikh), and Aditya Roy Kapur and Sanya Malhotra's leaked video. 2020.

Kriti Sanon as a dancer in Rajasthan who becomes a surrogate mother for an American couple to fund her Bollywood dreams, and they back out when tests say the baby may have Down syndrome; Pankaj Tripathi as the taxi driver Bhanu. 2021.

Vicky Kaushal as Field Marshal Sam Manekshaw, from the military academy and being shot in Burma to leading the army in the 1971 war; Sanya Malhotra as his wife Silloo and Fatima Sana Shaikh as Indira Gandhi. Meghna Gulzar, 2023.

Salman Khan as RAW agent Tiger and Katrina Kaif as Zoya take on Aatish Rehman (Emraan Hashmi), a rogue ex-ISI man plotting a coup in Pakistan; Shah Rukh cameo as Pathaan. Not Ek Tha Tiger or Tiger Zinda Hai.

Hrithik Roshan as Squadron Leader Shamsher 'Patty' Pathania and Deepika Padukone as Minni in the Air Dragons unit at Srinagar, with Anil Kapoor as Group Captain Rocky, answering the Pulwama attack with the Balakot strike. Siddharth Anand, 2024.
Kartik Aaryan as Murlikant Petkar, a wrestler turned army boxer who is shot several times in the 1965 war and later wins India's first Paralympic gold in swimming. Kabir Khan, 2024.

kartik aryan returns as fake ghostbuster Rooh Baba, hired for a haunted palace where Manjulika's spirit is locked; Vidya Balan and Madhuri Dixit both play women who seem to be Manjulika and dance together in 'Ami je tomar'. The third part, not the Akshay Kumar original.

Aamir Khan as Gulshan Arora, an arrogant basketball coach sentenced to community service training a team of intellectually disabled adults; Genelia D'Souza as his wife. Remake of the Spanish film Champions, 2025, not Taare Zameen Par.

ranvir singh as Hamza, an Indian agent who infiltrates the Lyari gangs of Karachi after the Kandahar hijack and the Parliament attack; Akshaye Khanna as Rehman Dakait, Sanjay Dutt as SP Chaudhary Aslam and R. Madhavan as IB chief Ajay Sanyal. Aditya Dhar, December 2025.

Sunny Deol is back as Lt Col Fateh Singh Kaler, with Varun Dhawan as Major Hoshiar Singh, Diljit Dosanjh as the pilot Nirmal Jit Singh Sekhon and Ahan Shetty in the navy, all fighting the 1971 war. 2026 sequel, not the 1997 original.

Very old Telugu mythological film where the giant Ghatotkacha uses magic to help Abhimanyu marry his love Sasirekha, he takes the form of the bride and eats the whole wedding feast in a famous song. Black and white, later colorized. NTR plays Krishna.

Classical music film from 1980 about an old Carnatic singer and a devadasi's daughter who worships him and his music. Her son becomes his student and the singer dies during a concert. Western pop music is mocked. Telugu, K. Viswanath.

Kamal Haasan plays a poor classical dancer who becomes an alcoholic after his mother dies, and his love Madhavi is a widow who can't marry him. He dances drunk on the edge of a well in the rain. Telugu, early 80s.

Simple-minded innocent village man ties a mangalsutra on a young widow at a temple festival to save her, and they build a life together. He grows old caring for her family. Kamal Haasan, Telugu, 80s. Oscar entry from India.

A painter neighbour inspires a girl from a family of Kuchipudi dancers who doesn't respect classical dance and just wants a normal job. She eventually performs in America. Venkatesh and Bhanupriya. Viswanath.
Mani Ratnam's only Telugu film, a young man with a terminal illness goes to a hill station and meets a crazy prankster girl who is also dying. Fog everywhere, Ilaiyaraaja music. Nagarjuna.

Ram Gopal Varma's first film, a college student fights student gangs and a gangster named Bhavani in Vijayawada. The iconic scene where the hero rips off a bicycle chain to fight. Nagarjuna. Late 80s.

Fantasy film where a goddess, the daughter of Indra, loses her ring on Earth and a tourist guide who takes care of orphans finds it. Lots of special effects for 1990. Chiranjeevi and Sridevi. 'abbanee teeyani' song.
Telugu science fiction where a time machine built by a professor takes the hero back to the court of Sri Krishnadevaraya and also into the future. Balakrishna. Early 90s, inspired by HG Wells.
Romantic family film where a fun-loving guy falls for the girl next door, their families agree and then a misunderstanding breaks it off. Nagarjuna and Tabu. Mid-90s Telugu hit, Krishna Vamsi.
Devotional biopic of the 15th century saint-poet who composed thousands of songs for Lord Venkateswara of Tirumala. A surprising role for Nagarjuna, who was a romantic hero then.

Feel-good family comedy, a guy from a village comes to stay at his father's rich friend's house in the city and falls for the friend's daughter, who is already engaged. Trivikram's dialogues, Venkatesh. Early 2000s Telugu.
Chiru works as a taxi driver in Varanasi but is secretly a powerful faction leader from Rayalaseema. Famous dance step. Faction violence and a water dispute between villages.

A kabaddi player from Hyderabad saves a girl from a powerful faction leader who wants to marry her and hides her in his own house. Huge Charminar set in the climax. Mahesh Babu, Prakash Raj as the villain.
College guy keeps telling a girl he loves her even though she's dating the college goon, 'feel my love' tagline. Allu Arjun with his crazy dancing. Sukumar's first film.

A professional hitman is framed for a politician's assassination and escapes by taking the identity of a man who died, living with that man's family in a village. Mahesh Babu and Trisha. Trivikram's dialogues. Cult status on TV.

Mahesh Babu plays a rowdy who works for the Hyderabad mafia, but the twist is he's actually an undercover police officer. Famous punch dialogue about mind block. Puri Jagannadh. Remade in Hindi as Wanted.

Son whose over-protective father decides everything for him falls for a bubbly chatterbox girl, and the father reluctantly lets her live with the family for a week. Genelia's character Hasini is famous. Siddharth, 2006 Telugu.
Romantic film mostly on a boat trip down the Godavari river to Bhadrachalam, a guy who wants to be a politician and a girl who runs a boutique. Sekhar Kammula, gentle and slow. Sumanth.
Eight friends' four years in an engineering college in Hyderabad, ragging, crushes, misunderstandings. All new actors, Tamannaah was one of them. 'oh my friend' song. Telugu, 2007.

Reincarnation story where a bike racer touches a girl's hand and remembers his past life 400 years ago as a royal bodyguard. He fights 100 warriors alone. I think Prabhas was the hero. Rajamouli. Sand dunes horse chase.

Horror fantasy where a young woman returns to her ancestral palace and learns that she is the reincarnation of a queen who buried an evil black-magic sorcerer alive. Sonu Sood as the scary villain Pasupathi. Anushka Shetty. Not Baahubali.

Comedy where a poor man unknowingly enters the house of a family that wants to kill him in a blood feud, but by their tradition they can't harm a guest inside their home, so he refuses to leave. Comedian Sunil as hero. Rajamouli. Remade in Hindi as Son of Sardaar.

A cop's politician father wakes from a long coma and can't take any shock, so the son pretends he's still an MLA with the help of a fake reality show. Mahesh Babu comedy action. Brahmanandam is hilarious.
A young man is killed by a rich businessman who wants his girlfriend, and he is reborn as a housefly who takes revenge. Telugu, Rajamouli, Sudeep plays the villain. Also dubbed in Hindi as Makkhi.
A rich young man from Italy comes to India disguised as a driver to bring his estranged aunt back to his grandfather. Power star's biggest hit, Trivikram. The film leaked online before release.

Three generations of the same acting family in one film, a reincarnation story where a son meets his dead parents reborn as young people. It was the grandfather's last film before he died. Feel-good and a bit confusing.

A boy found by villagers below a giant waterfall keeps trying to climb it, and above he discovers a kingdom and his real identity. Ends on a cliffhanger where the loyal old general stabs the hero. Telugu, 2015, Rajamouli, Prabhas. Not the conclusion.
A billionaire's son adopts his father's ancestral village to develop it and fights the local goons there. Cycling scene. Mahesh Babu, social message, Koratala Siva.

Thriller where a man returns from the US to help his ex-girlfriend find her kidnapped daughter, but the police and everyone else insist the little girl never existed. Adivi Sesh. Low budget Telugu hit, remade as Baaghi 2.

A lazy guy who wants to be a chef and an ambitious girl get locked in her room by mistake during a bride-viewing meeting, they talk and later start a food truck together. Vijay Deverakonda before he was famous.

The sequel that finally answers why the loyal slave general killed the king. Amarendra marries a warrior princess Devasena, the evil cousin plots, and the son takes revenge. Biggest Indian box office hit at the time. Not the first part.

Brilliant surgeon with anger issues falls for a junior, her family marries her off, and he spirals into alcohol and drugs, with his dog. The original Telugu film, not the Hindi remake. Vijay Deverakonda.

NRI medical student visits a Telangana village for his brother's wedding and falls for the bride's feisty younger sister who refuses to leave her father and move to America. Sai Pallavi's 'vachinde' dance. Sekhar Kammula.

Set in a 1980s village in Godavari, a partially deaf young man who runs a water motor for the fields fights the village president who has ruled for 30 years, after his brother is killed. Ram Charan. Sukumar.

Biopic of a legendary South Indian actress of the 50s and 60s, her rise, troubled marriage to a married actor, alcoholism and coma. Told through two journalists in the 80s. Keerthy Suresh won a national award. Telugu.

Small independent film with real locals as actors, four love stories in a neighbourhood of Vizag across different ages, a schoolboy, a liquor shop guy, a 49 year old bachelor, and a twist at the end connects them. Not a typical masala film.

Four childhood friends in Hyderabad who once wanted to make films reunite at a bachelor party, get drunk and accidentally end up in Goa, and decide to make a short film. Tharun Bhascker, cult among youth. Not Pelli Choopulu.
Telugu spy thriller where a young agent trained by a secret organisation called Trinetra is framed for killing his own team and must clear his name. Adivi Sesh. Low budget James Bond style.

A failed cricketer in his late 30s makes a comeback to the Ranji team just to buy his son a cricket jersey, hiding a heart problem. Set in the 80s and 90s. Very emotional ending. Nani. Not the Shahid Kapoor remake.

Comedy detective film where a small-time private investigator in Nellore stumbles onto a racket involving unclaimed dead bodies and gets framed himself. Naveen Polishetty's debut as lead. Sherlock-like.

Two babies are swapped at birth in a hospital, the poor one grows up a middle-class guy and later works for his real rich family without them knowing. Songs 'butta bomma' and 'samajavaragamana' were huge. Allu Arjun, 2020.
Three idiot friends from a small town go to Hyderabad, get framed for trying to murder a minister and accidentally become suspects. Naveen Polishetty, Priyadarshi, Rahul Ramakrishna. Pure comedy.

A daily-wage coolie rises in a red sandalwood smuggling syndicate in the Seshachalam forests, with a slouched shoulder and beard-stroke gesture. 'thaggede le' and 'srivalli'. Allu Arjun. First part, not the Rule.

Two Indian revolutionaries in the 1920s, one a cop working for the British, the other a tribal leader trying to rescue a girl from a British governor's house, become best friends. 'naatu naatu' dance won the Oscar. Jr NTR and Ram Charan. Tiger jumping out of a truck.

A lonely army soldier in Kashmir in the 60s receives love letters from a mysterious woman named Sita, years later a Pakistani student is forced to deliver his letter to her. Dulquer Salmaan. Beautiful songs. Telugu.

Dark violent action, a quiet mechanic is actually a ferocious warrior who protects his childhood friend Vardha, the prince of a fictional city-state called Khansaar where the throne is contested. Prabhas. Same director as KGF.

Small village boy gains superpowers from a gem formed from Lord Hanuman's blood and fights a villain who wants to be a superhero. Low budget Telugu superhero film that became a huge hit in 2024. Teja Sajja.

Dystopian future in the last city Kasi, a bounty hunter gets entangled protecting a pregnant woman whose unborn child is the prophesied saviour, and an ancient immortal warrior from the Mahabharata played by Amitabh guards her. Prabhas, Deepika. Sci-fi with mythology.

Sequel of the red sandalwood smuggler story, he dresses up in a saree with makeup for a village goddess festival dance and fights the arrogant cop Shekhawat again. Biggest hit of 2024. Not the first part.

Vijayashanti as ASP Vyjayanthi, an honest police officer who takes on the corrupt local leader Muddu Krishnayya and his son; the role won her the National Award for best actress and the title 'Lady Amitabh'.

Chiranjeevi as Kondaveeti Raja, an orphan raised by a tribal village who studies to become an IAS officer and returns to fight the landlords and smugglers exploiting the villagers; Vijayashanti and Radha. The first Telugu film in 70mm, 1990.

Chiranjeevi as Rajaram, the jobless youngest of three brothers who roams the city with his four friends, and after his brother is murdered he takes on the villains; Vijayashanti, the song 'Vaana Vaana Velluvaye'.

Ram Gopal Varma thriller: Sridevi as Satya and Venkatesh as a petty thief, Chandu, on the run through a forest from both the police and Paresh Rawal's gangster Nayar after stolen bank money ends up hidden in her house.
Chiranjeevi in a double role as Kalyan, an industrialist framed by his enemies, and Johnny, a Bombay auto driver lookalike they put in his place; Divya Bharti and Shobana. K. Raghavendra Rao.

K. Viswanath film with Chiranjeevi as Madhava, a loyal cowherd who plays Lord Shiva in village dramas and silently loves his teacher's daughter Hema (Meenakshi Seshadri), later rescuing her from a mental asylum.
Venkatesh as Chanti, an innocent village singer who grows up serving a zamindar family and falls for their pampered sister Nandini (Meena); remake of the Tamil hit Chinna Thambi.
Chiranjeevi as Raju, a worker who marries the arrogant factory owner Uma Devi (Nagma) and tames her; the 'Bangaru Kodipetta' song, K. Raghavendra Rao, early 90s blockbuster.

Rajasekhar as Raja, a musician who falls for the girl whose poems he sets to music, but the poems were secretly written by Lalitha (Ramya Krishna) under her friend Kavitha's name; M. M. Keeravani songs.

Ram Gopal Varma production: two jobless friends, Chakri (J. D. Chakravarthy) and Bose, kidnap a rich man's wife for ransom, but the husband Subba Rao (Paresh Rawal) actually wants her dead; Brahmanandam as Khan Dada.
Nagarjuna in a double role as twins separated at birth who feel each other's pain, one a thief and one a singer; Ramya Krishna and Soundarya. E. V. V. Satyanarayana comedy.
Jagapathi Babu as Madhu, whose materialistic wife Radha (Aamani) agrees to let his boss's rich daughter Latha (Roja) marry him in exchange for a crore of rupees, and then regrets it.
Comedian Ali as Suraj, who finds the book of the future that Yama lost on earth, and Yama (Kaikala Satyanarayana) and Chitragupta come down to get it back; S. V. Krishna Reddy.
Krishna Vamsi's first film: J. D. Chakravarthy as Chandu, who falls for Pooja (Maheswari) and has to save her from a gang trafficking young girls to Dubai.
Mohan Babu in a double role as Pedarayudu, the respected village elder who sits in judgment, and his brother Raja; Rajinikanth has a guest role as their father; Soundarya and Bhanupriya.
Venkatesh as Vijay, a westernised rich son who agrees to marry Radha (Soundarya) only on a one-year contract and slowly falls for her; S. P. Balasubrahmanyam plays his father.

Srikanth as Vijay Krishna, a musician from a musical family searching for the girl he saw in a dream without seeing her face, with Ravali and Deepti Bhatnagar; K. Raghavendra Rao with M. M. Keeravani's hit songs.
Chiranjeevi as Madhava Rao, a hot-tempered elder brother who raises his five sisters so strictly that the local youth call him 'Hitler'; Rajendra Prasad as Balu, remake of a Malayalam film.
Chiranjeevi as Rajkumar, a Telugu lecturer brought in by his old principal to discipline an unruly college, who fights the drug dealer Devaraju (Puneet Issar); Sakshi Sivanand.
Venkatesh as Anand, a millionaire who shelters Santhi (Soundarya), a rape survivor thrown out by her family after she reported a murder; Laila co-stars. Muthyala Subbaiah.
Venkatesh as Giri, a college student who falls for Kaveri (Anjala Zaveri), daughter of the Rayalaseema factionist Veerabhadraiah who hates love marriages; Srihari as his henchman Sivudu.
Krishna Vamsi's film about Naxalites: Brahmaji as Bulliraju, a trainee police officer, and Ravi Teja as his village friend Chanti who joins the rebels; Soundarya.

Soundarya as Bhanu, who comes from Mauritius to her husband's Rayalaseema village and has to escape with her son from her violent factionist father-in-law Narasimha (Prakash Raj); Jagapathi Babu helps her.

Chiranjeevi as Ramakrishna, a mechanic who goes to Calcutta to rescue his son from his wife's gangster father Mahendra (Prakash Raj); Soundarya and Anjala Zaveri, the song 'Ramma Chilakamma'. Gunasekhar.
Venkatesh in a double role as Harischandra Prasad, the respected village head, and his uneducated son Bhanu Prasad whom he disowns, who builds a bus business with Meena; remake of the Tamil hit.
Pawan Kalyan as Balu, a carefree youth who sees Anu (Keerthi Reddy) on a Diwali night and falls in love but can't confess until she leaves for America; won a National Award. Not the 2018 film.

Venkatesh as Raja, a petty thief who, with his friend Balu, hides in a house after stealing a Ganesha idol, is locked in the kitchen by the governess Anjali (Soundarya), and falls in love with her; Abbas co-stars.
Pawan Kalyan as Subbu, a lazy younger brother who fights the kickboxing final after his elder brother Chakri is injured; remake of Jo Jeeta Wohi Sikandar.

Pawan Kalyan as Badri, an ad film director who accepts his fiancée Vennela's challenge to make another girl, Sarayu (Amisha Patel), fall for him; Prakash Raj as her brother Nanda. Puri Jagannadh's first film.
Venkatesh as Raghu, the grandson from Bombay who comes for his grandfather's (K. Viswanath) 60th birthday ceremony and brings the two feuding families together; Simran.
Tarun and Richa Pallod as Tarun and Madhu, childhood best friends born on the same day who don't realise they love each other; the song 'Anaganaga Aakasam Undi'.
Pawan Kalyan as Siddhu and Bhumika as Madhu, two proud college students who fall in love but keep fighting over their egos; S. J. Suryah, the famous waist scene.
Mahesh Babu as Murari, heir of a zamindar family cursed by the goddess so that a male heir dies every 48 years; Sonali Bendre as Vasundhara. Krishna Vamsi.
Balakrishna as Narasimha Naidu, a dance teacher in Visakhapatnam who was actually given by his father to protect the village from the rival Appala Naidu's faction; Simran.
Uday Kiran as Ravi, a millionaire's son, and Anita as Vasundhara, a milkman's daughter, college lovers whose families try to separate them; director Teja.
NTR Jr. as Aditya, who studies at a law college and reforms the rowdy students, and is revealed to be a convict serving a murder sentence; S. S. Rajamouli's first film.

NTR Jr. as Aadhi Kesava Reddy, who as a boy back from the US sees his father killed by the factionist Nagi Reddy over their land, and grows up to return to Rayalaseema for revenge; Keerthi Chawla, V. V. Vinayak's debut.
Ravi Teja as Chanti, a carefree head constable's son who falls for Suchitra (Rakshita), the police commissioner's daughter who saved his life by giving her blood; Puri Jagannadh.

Nagarjuna as Abhiram, an ad agency manager who hates women because of his past with Maheswari (Anshu), until his new assistant Harika (Sonali Bendre) changes him; Brahmanandam's comedy track on the Paris trip.
Nagarjuna as Karthik, an architect in Ooty whose wife Padmavathi (Gracy Singh) dies, and her cousin Bhanu (Shriya) who helps raise his son; Prabhu Deva as Pavan.
Ravi Teja as Chandu, a kickboxer raised by his mother who goes to live with his estranged rich father (Prakash Raj) and falls for a Tamil girl nicknamed Chennai (Asin); Puri Jagannadh.
Allu Arjun's debut as Simhadri, son of a factionist's loyal follower, who loves his master's daughter Gangotri, cursed with a danger from water; K. Raghavendra Rao's 100th film.
NTR Jr. as Simhadri, an orphan raised by a rich family in Visakhapatnam who secretly looks after a mentally ill girl, Indu (Bhumika), and has a violent past in Kerala as Singamalai; S. S. Rajamouli.
Chiranjeevi as Ravindranath Tagore, a professor who secretly runs the Anti-Corruption Force that kidnaps officials and executes the most corrupt one; remake of Ramanaa, V. V. Vinayak.
Sekhar Kammula film: Roopa (Kamalinee Mukherjee) walks out of her wedding when the groom's mother insults her late mother's saree, and a rich young man, Anand (Raja), quietly falls for her.
Nagarjuna as Ganesh alias Mass, an orphan who falls for Anjali (Jyothika), daughter of a crippled crime boss in Vizag, and takes on his enemies; Raghava Lawrence's debut as director.

Chiranjeevi as Shankar Dada, a Hyderabad goon who pretends to be a doctor for his parents and then forces his way into medical college, with Srikanth as his sidekick ATM. The Telugu remake, not Munna Bhai.
Prabhas as Venkat and Trisha as Sailu, who meet dancing in the rain on a train journey, while the ruthless factionist Bhadranna (Gopichand) becomes obsessed with her; rain songs.
Kalyan Ram as Ram, a college student who joins Anjali (Sindhu Tolani) and her uncle in killing the powerful men behind a crime against her family; Surender Reddy's first film.

Ravi Teja as Bhadra, a student who brings a frightened girl, Anu (Meera Jasmine), home for his sister's wedding; her family was wiped out by the factionist Veerayya and he protects her. Boyapati Srinu's debut.
Allu Arjun as Bunny, who joins college and wins over Mahalakshmi, daughter of the Vizag businessman and crime boss Somaraju (Prakash Raj), with a hidden plan against her father; V. V. Vinayak.
Prabhas as Sivaji, separated from his stepmother Parvati (Bhanupriya) as a boy when Sri Lankan refugees flee to Vizag, who grows up as the dockworkers' protector Chatrapathi; S. S. Rajamouli.
Siddharth as Santosh, a rich city boy who falls for Siri (Trisha), and her brother Sivaramakrishna (Srihari) makes him work in the fields to prove himself; Prabhu Deva's first film as director.
Chiranjeevi as Major Stalin, a former army officer who asks everyone he helps to help three more people, against the Home Minister played by Prakash Raj; Trisha. A. R. Murugadoss.
Ram Charan's debut as Charan, who goes to jail as a boy after avenging his father's murder by the gangster Mattu Bhai, and later falls for the rich, arrogant Sanjana (Neha Sharma); Puri Jagannadh.

Allu Arjun as Bala Govind, a TV channel program director who hides in a Himalayan ashram from a smuggler's revenge and falls for Vaishali (Hansika Motwani), who is meant to become a sanyasini; Puri Jagannadh.

Manchu Vishnu as Babloo, a carefree guy whose father gets him a job with the don Shankar Goud (Srihari), and who falls for the don's sister Pooja (Genelia); Brahmanandam as Chary. Srinu Vaitla comedy.
NTR Jr. as Raja, a thief who is killed and fights his way through Yamaloka against Yama (Mohan Babu) to return to earth and Mahi (Priyamani); S. S. Rajamouli.
Sharwanand as Abhiram, a rich spoilt young man who rides through Andhra villages looking for Dr. Janaki (Kamalinee Mukherjee) with a small-time thief, Gaali Seenu (Allari Naresh); Krish's first film.
Pawan Kalyan as Sanju, an aerobics instructor and former Naxalite whose past with a police officer catches up with him; Ileana as Bhagi; Trivikram Srinivas.
Varun Sandesh as Balu and Shweta Basu Prasad as Swapna, students at a residential college in Visakhapatnam whose romance is broken up by her strict father (Prakash Raj); Srikanth Addala.

Ram Pothineni as Chandu, who helps lovers elope, kidnaps Pooja (Genelia D'Souza) from the wrong wedding by mistake, and then wins over her two feuding uncles by posing as an auditor; Brahmanandam as McDowell Murthy. Srinu Vaitla.
Allu Arjun as Arya, an orphan obsessively attached to his friend Ajay (Navdeep) from the orphanage, and both love Geetha (Kajal Aggarwal); Sukumar. The second one, not the first Arya.

Ravi Teja as Kalyan, a thrill-seeker who needs a 'kick' in everything and secretly robs rich men to pay for poor children's operations, chased by cop Kalyan Krishna (Shaam); Ileana. Not the Salman Khan remake.
NTR Jr. as Krish, a rich guy who pretends to be Bhoomi's (Kajal Aggarwal) boyfriend to save her from a marriage and reunites her feuding family; Samantha as Indu.
Prabhas as Prabha, who invents a story about his past to escape an arranged match and is really in love with his childhood friend Nandini (Kajal Aggarwal), daughter of his father's college friend.
Mahesh Babu as Raju, a Hyderabad cab driver who goes to Rajasthan and is believed to be the god-sent saviour of a plague-hit desert village; Anushka Shetty, Trivikram Srinivas.
Balakrishna in a double role as Srimannarayana, a short-tempered lecturer, and his father Dr. Narasimha, a doctor murdered by villains; Nayanthara. Boyapati Srinu.

Krish's anthology: five strangers, a slum cable guy (Allu Arjun), a rockstar (Manoj Manchu), a sex worker (Anushka Shetty), a poor weaver and a Muslim man, end up at a hospital during a terror attack.
Naga Chaitanya as Balu, a college topper who competes with his cousin Mahalakshmi (Tamannaah) for first rank, and their ego clashes turn into love; Sukumar.
Nani as Gautam and Nithya Menen as Nithya, who keep meeting at each other's exes' weddings, with Gautam telling the story to the man who kidnapped him (Ashish Vidyarthi); Nandini Reddy.
Prabhas as Vicky, an Australia-based game developer who refuses to compromise for love, between childhood friend Priya (Kajal Aggarwal) and Maggie (Taapsee Pannu); Dasaradh.
Mahesh Babu as Surya, who comes to Mumbai to build a mafia empire like a business, against the police commissioner whose daughter Chitra (Kajal Aggarwal) he woos; Puri Jagannadh.

Pawan Kalyan as Venkataratnam Naidu, who renames himself Gabbar Singh after the Sholay villain and becomes a fun-loving cop in Kondaveedu fighting Siddhappa Naidu; Shruti Haasan. The Telugu remake, not Dabangg.
Allu Arjun as Ravi, a lazy but clever guy in Vizag who accidentally foils a ₹1,500 crore bank robbery planned by Bittu (Sonu Sood) and gets hunted by him; Ileana, Trivikram Srinivas.
Ram Charan as Raj alias Cherry, a gambler who takes a bet to make Chaitra (Tamannaah), daughter of the mining baron Bellary, fall for him, to pay for his father's liver transplant.

Prabhas as Jai, who meets Manasa (Richa Gangopadhyay) in Milan and goes to live with her violent faction family to change them, hiding his own past as Deva's (Sathyaraj) son; Anushka Shetty, Koratala Siva's debut.
Ram Charan in a double role as Siddharth Naayak, a vigilante wanted in Kolkata, and Cherry, his lookalike in Hyderabad; Kajal Aggarwal and Amala Paul, Brahmanandam as Jilebi. V. V. Vinayak.
Venkatesh and Mahesh Babu as the brothers Peddodu and Chinnodu in a warm joint family led by Relangi Mavayya (Prakash Raj); Anjali as Seetha and Samantha; Srikanth Addala.
Nikhil Siddharth as Surya, a pickpocket who gets hold of a stolen golden Ganesha idol that the gangster Durga Prasad (Ravi Babu) wants; Swati Reddy. Sudheer Varma's caper.

Venkatesh as Rambabu, a film-loving cable operator in the Araku area who covers up his daughter's accidental killing of the IG's son, with Meena as his wife. The Telugu remake, not the Ajay Devgn one.
Balakrishna in a double role as Krishna, back from abroad for his wedding, and his elder brother Jaidev, a local legend who fought the cruel factionist Jitendra (Jagapathi Babu); Boyapati Srinu.
Nani as Lucky, an absent-minded botanist who forgets what he is doing halfway, hiding it from his girlfriend Nandana (Lavanya Tripathi) and her father; Maruthi comedy.
Varun Tej as Haribabu, a lower-caste student who loves the princess Sitadevi (Pragya Jaiswal) in 1930s Madras, and later fights as an Indian soldier in World War II Italy; Krish.
Allu Arjun as Viraj Anand, who gives up ₹300 crore of assets to pay his late father's debts and keep his honest name, then works as a wedding planner; Samantha and Upendra, Trivikram.

NTR Jr. as Daya, a corrupt sub-inspector in Vizag working for the don Waltair Vasu (Prakash Raj), who turns after a girl's rape and murder and even confesses to the crime to get the culprits hanged; Puri Jagannadh.
Nani as Subbu, a money-minded corporate man who treks to Everest base camp to fulfil his late friend Rishi's (Vijay Deverakonda) wish and finds himself; Malavika Nair. Nag Ashwin's first film.
Samantha as Anasuya, who escapes her strict mother to stay at her relatives' village near Vijayawada and falls for her cousin Anand Vihari (Nithiin), who is meant to marry Valli; Trivikram.
NTR Jr. as Abhiram, who in London sets out to destroy the billionaire Krishna Murthy Kautilya (Jagapathi Babu) within a month to avenge his terminally ill father (Rajendra Prasad); Sukumar.
Nagarjuna as Vikramaditya, a quadriplegic billionaire, and Karthi as Seenu, the ex-convict who becomes his carer; Tamannaah. Remake of The Intouchables.
Allu Arjun as Gana, an ex-army officer who takes on Vairam Dhanush (Aadhi Pinisetty), the ruthless son of a chief minister; Rakul Preet Singh, Boyapati Srinu.
Rana Daggubati as Lt Cdr Arjun Varma aboard the submarine S21, hunting the Pakistani submarine PNS Ghazi off Visakhapatnam in 1971; Kay Kay Menon as the captain, Taapsee Pannu.
Chiranjeevi's comeback in a double role: Kaththi Seenu, an escaped convict, and Siva Shankara Vara Prasad, a man fighting a company over farmers' water; Kajal Aggarwal, remake of Kaththi.
Nani as Uma, a dance teacher who loved Pallavi (Nivetha Thomas); after she marries Arun (Aadhi Pinisetty), Arun invites Uma to stay with them in the US to see she is happy.

NTR Jr. as Veera Raghava Reddy, who after his father's murder in a 30-year village feud tries to make peace instead of taking revenge, guided by Aravinda (Pooja Hegde); Jagapathi Babu as Basi Reddy, Trivikram.
Anushka Shetty as Chanchala, a jailed IAS officer questioned in an abandoned palace, where she seems possessed by the queen Bhaagamathie; Unni Mukundan and Jayaram.
Vijay Deverakonda as Shiva, a cab driver whose second-hand car turns out to be possessed by the spirit of a dead woman; Priyanka Jawalkar and Malavika Nair.

Sree Vishnu as Rahul and Nivetha Thomas as Mithra: three college friends fake Mithra's kidnapping to help her, while a director (Satyadev) narrates his film to an actress (Nivetha Pethuraj); Vivek Athreya.
Vijay Deverakonda as Bobby, a hot-headed student union leader, and Rashmika Mandanna as Lilly, a state-level cricketer who later fights the selector who harassed her; Bharat Kamma.
Adivi Sesh as Vikram Vasudev, a corrupt cop questioning Sameera (Regina Cassandra), a businesswoman who killed a DSP claiming self-defence; twisty thriller, remake of The Invisible Guest.
Venkatesh and Varun Tej as Venky and Varun, frustrated by their wife and girlfriend, the sisters Harika (Tamannaah) and Honey (Mehreen), who run off to Europe; Anil Ravipudi.
Mahesh Babu as Rishi, a US company CEO who returns to India to stand by his college friend Ravi (Allari Naresh) and ends up fighting for farmers; Pooja Hegde, Vamshi Paidipally.
Naga Chaitanya as Poorna, a failed cricketer in Vizag heartbroken over his first love Anshu, and Samantha as Sravani, the wife who silently waits for him to love her.
Priyadarshi as Chintakindi Mallesham, a weaver who invents the asu machine to save his mother from the painful work of winding silk threads by hand; biopic.
Lakshmi plays the 70-year-old Baby, who becomes 24 again after a photo studio visit, played by Samantha, and gets a second chance at singing; remake of Miss Granny.

Prabhas as the undercover cop Ashok Chakravarthy, who turns out to be Saaho, hidden heir of a crime syndicate in the fictional Waaji City, chasing a huge heist; Shraddha Kapoor and Jackie Shroff. Sujeeth.
Chiranjeevi as Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy, a Rayalaseema chieftain who rebels against the East India Company in the 1840s; Sudeep, Vijay Sethupathi, and Amitabh Bachchan as his guru.
Ram Pothineni as iSmart Shankar, an old-city Hyderabad hitman who gets a murdered cop's memories implanted into his brain, 'double dhimaak'; Nabha Natesh and Nidhhi Agerwal, Puri Jagannadh.
Nithiin as Bheeshma, a jobless single guy who turns out to be the heir chosen to run his grandfather's (Anant Nag) organic farming company, Bheeshma Organics; Rashmika Mandanna.
Suhas as Jayakrishna, a dark-skinned college student in the 1990s who loves Deepthi (Chandini Chowdary), and her police officer brother (Sunil) who hates him for his colour; National Award winner.

Vishwak Sen as Vikram Rudraraju, a cop with PTSD in the Homicide Intervention Team searching for a missing woman while his girlfriend Neha also goes missing; Sailesh Kolanu. The first case, not the Nani one.
Ravi Teja as CI Potharaju Veera Shankar, a tough cop who takes on the Ongole gangster Katari Krishna (Samuthirakani); Shruti Haasan, Gopichand Malineni.
Naga Chaitanya as Revanth, a Dalit Christian who runs a Zumba centre in Hyderabad, and Sai Pallavi as Mounika, an upper-caste girl hiding abuse by her uncle; Sekhar Kammula.
Nani in a double role as Vasu, a young film director in Hyderabad, and Shyam Singha Roy, a 1970s Bengali writer and reformer who loved the devadasi Maithreyi (Sai Pallavi); reincarnation story.
Panja Vaisshnav Tej as Aasi, a fisherman's son who loves Bebamma (Krithi Shetty), daughter of the brutal zamindar Raayanam (Vijay Sethupathi), who punishes him horribly for it; Buchi Babu Sana.

Pawan Kalyan as advocate Satyadev, who defends three working women (Nivetha Thomas, Anjali, Ananya Nagalla) accused of attacking a politician's son; Prakash Raj as the opposing lawyer. The Telugu remake, not Pink.
Pawan Kalyan as SI Bheemla Nayak and Rana Daggubati as ex-havildar Daniel Shekhar, whose ego war starts when Danny is caught with liquor at a forest checkpost; remake of Ayyappanum Koshiyum.
Kalyan Ram as the cruel king Bimbisara of 500 BC, transported through a magic mirror to the present day, and his twin brother Devadutta; Catherine Tresa and Samyuktha.

Siddhu Jonnalagadda as Tillu, a loud wannabe DJ in Hyderabad who helps Radhika (Neha Shetty) hide the body of a man who died in her flat; the 'Tillu Anna DJ Pedithe' song. The first one, not Tillu Square.
Adivi Sesh as Major Sandeep Unnikrishnan, the NSG commando killed during the 26/11 attack on the Taj hotel in Mumbai; Prakash Raj and Revathi as his parents.
Mahesh Babu as Mahi, a ruthless loan recovery agent in Miami who comes to Visakhapatnam to recover a debt from MP Rajendranath (Samuthirakani), father of Kalaavathi (Keerthy Suresh), who cheated him.

Vaishnavi Chaitanya as Vaishu, a girl from a Hyderabad slum who changes at engineering college and is torn between her childhood love Anand (Anand Deverakonda), an auto driver, and rich classmate Viraj; Sai Rajesh.
Priyadarshi as Sayilu in a Telangana village where grandfather Komurayya dies and the crows won't touch the funeral offering until the quarrelling family reconciles; Venu Yeldandi.
Balakrishna as Bhagavanth Kesari, an ex-convict who raises his late friend's daughter Viji (Sreeleela) and pushes her to join the army despite her fears; Arjun Rampal as the villain, Anil Ravipudi.
Nani as Dharani in the coal-mining village of Veerlapally, who gives up Vennela (Keerthy Suresh) for his best friend Suri, who is murdered on their wedding night; Srikanth Odela.
Nani as Viraj, a Mumbai fashion photographer raising his daughter Mahi, who has cystic fibrosis, and Mrunal Thakur as Yashna, who turns out to be the mother Mahi never knew.
Sai Dharam Tej as Surya, who visits the village of Rudravanam in 1991 as people start dying mysteriously, 12 years after a couple was lynched for black magic; Samyuktha as Nandini.
Chiranjeevi as Waltair Veerayya, a Vizag fishermen's leader hired to capture the drug lord Solomon Caesar from Malaysia, with Ravi Teja as his half-brother ACP Vikram Sagar; Shruti Haasan.
NTR Jr. in a double role as Devara, the feared leader of a coastal village who stops his men smuggling weapons by sea, and his timid son Vara; Saif Ali Khan as Bhaira, Janhvi Kapoor. Part one.
Mahesh Babu as Rowdy Ramana, left behind as a boy in Guntur by his mother (Ramya Krishna), now a minister, who is asked to sign away his rights as her son; Sreeleela, Trivikram.
Dulquer Salmaan as Baskhar, a poor bank cashier in early 1990s Bombay who gets rich in a securities scam using the bank's money, breaking the fourth wall; Meenakshi Chaudhary.

Siddhu Jonnalagadda back as DJ Tillu, now an event manager, who falls for the mysterious Lilly (Anupama Parameswaran) and gets dragged into a plan against a drug lord. The sequel, not the first DJ Tillu.

Balakrishna returns in a double role as the aghora Akhanda and MLA Bala Murali Krishna, protecting the nation and a young girl, Janani; Aadhi Pinisetty and Samyuktha. The sequel, not the first Akhanda.
Priyadarshi as Surya Teja, a junior lawyer who defends Chandrashekar, a 19-year-old falsely charged under the POCSO act for loving a girl, against her controlling uncle Mangapathi (Sivaji).

Balakrishna as Sitaram, an engineer who became the dacoit Daaku Maharaaj fighting Balwant Singh Thakur (Bobby Deol), and who now protects a little girl and her grandfather in Madanapalle; Shraddha Srinath.
Nani as SP Arjun Sarkaar, a violent HIT officer who goes undercover inside a dark web network of killers; Srinidhi Shetty. The third case, not the first HIT.
Teja Sajja as Vedha, an orphan pickpocket who learns he is destined to protect the nine sacred granthas of Emperor Ashoka from the Black Sword (Manchu Manoj); Jayaram.

Venkatesh as YD Raju, an ex-cop pulled back to rescue a kidnapped businessman, caught between his wife Bhagyam (Aishwarya Rajesh) and his ex-girlfriend Meenakshi (Meenakshi Chaudhary); Anil Ravipudi's Sankranti hit.
Pawan Kalyan as Ojas Gambheera, OG, a samurai-trained gangster who returns to Bombay to protect Satya Dada's (Prakash Raj) family from Omi Bhau (Emraan Hashmi); Sujeeth.
Prabhas as RajaSaab, who searches for his grandfather Kanakaraju (Sanjay Dutt), an exorcist, for the sake of his grandmother with Alzheimer's, and ends up in a haunted mansion; Maruthi horror comedy.
